primer_references.title: Commander Kryptonite: How to Beat Chulane, Teller of Tales
key_points: Engine: every creature cast draws a card and may put a land into play via Chulane; Chulane activation (3 mana, tap) bounces an own creature for recasting
Combo axis: Aluren (creatures MV <= 3 free) + Shrieking Drake (bounces itself) draws the whole deck, plays all lands, builds storm count
Plan B: Village Bell-Ringer / Intruder Alarm as second loop axis with mana dorks

Strengths per author: overwhelming resource engine, resilient against board wipes/removal; weaknesses: commander-dependent (repeated removal stalls the deck), few large threats, 'spinning wheels' without a real finisher
Cards the author warns about: Destiny Spinner, Scute Swarm, Aura Shards, Village Bell-Ringer, Oko, Thief of Crowns
transfer_limitations: COUNTER-guide only, never a build primer: usable for mechanics/strategy, not as a recommendation
Author estimate 'Bracket Four combo deck' is editorial, not a measurement
Aluren/Bell-Ringer axis NOT in the target deck; the guide supports the diagnosis 'value deck without combo finisher', not a combo rebuild
